questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Togo?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Togo article.

questions.proof: The capital city Lomé is located along the Gulf of Guinea.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Togo?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Togo on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Togo article.

questions.proof: It is bordered by Ghana to the west, Benin to the east and Burkina Faso to the north.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Togo?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Togo article.
